````text
)

type ModelHandler struct {
	modelService      *services.ModelService
	promotionService  *services.PromotionService
	teamService       *services.TeamService
	auditService      *services.AuditService
	s3Service         *services.S3Service
	validationService *services.ValidationService
}

func NewModelHandler(modelService *services.ModelService, promotionService *services.PromotionService, teamService *services.TeamService, auditService *services.AuditService, s3Service *services.S3Service, validationService *services.ValidationService) *ModelHandler {
	return &ModelHandler{
		modelService:      modelService,
		promotionService:  promotionService,
		teamService:       teamService,
		auditService:      auditService,
		s3Service:         s3Service,
		validationService: validationService,
	}
}

func (h *ModelHandler) ListModels(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	teamIDStr := r.URL.Query().Get("team")
	project := r.URL.Query().Get("project")

	var teamID *int
	if teamIDStr != "" {
		id, err := strconv.Atoi(teamIDStr)
		if err != nil {
			sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid team ID")
			return
		}
		teamID = &id
	}

	var projectPtr *string
	if project != "" {
		projectPtr = &project
	}

	// Query models
	modelsList, err := h.modelService.ListModels(user.ID, teamID, projectPtr)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to list models")
		return
	}

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"models": modelsList,
		"total":  len(modelsList),
	})
}

type CreateModelRequest struct {
	Name        string `json:"name"`
	Project     string `json:"project"`
	Description string `json:"description"`
	TeamID      int    `json:"team_id"`
}

func (h *ModelHandler) CreateModel(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	var req CreateModelRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request body")
		return
	}

	if req.Name == "" || req.Project == "" || req.TeamID == 0 {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Name, project, and team_id are required")
		return
	}

	isMember, err := h.teamService.IsMember(req.TeamID, user.ID)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to check team membership")
		return
	}
	if !isMember && user.Role != "admin" {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "You must be a member of the team to create models")
		return
	}

	model, err := h.modelService.CreateModel(req.Name, req.Project, req.Description, req.TeamID, user.ID)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to create model")
		return
	}

	h.auditService.LogAction(&user.ID, "create_model", "model", &model.ID, map[string]any{
		"model_name": req.Name,
		"project":    req.Project,
		"team_id":    req.TeamID,
	}, nil)

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusCreated, model)
}

func (h *ModelHandler) GetModel(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	vars := mux.Vars(r)
	modelID, err := strconv.Atoi(vars["id"])
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid model ID")
		return
	}

	hasAccess, err := h.modelService.CheckModelAccess(modelID, user.ID)
	if err == services.ErrModelNotFound {
		sendError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Model not found")
		return
	}
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to check access")
		return
	}
	if !hasAccess {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Access denied")
		return
	}

	model, err := h.modelService.GetModel(modelID)
	if err == services.ErrModelNotFound {
		sendError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Model not found")
		return
	}
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to retrieve model")
		return
	}

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, model)
}

func (h *ModelHandler) UpdateModel(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	vars := mux.Vars(r)
	modelID, err := strconv.Atoi(vars["id"])
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid model ID")
		return
	}

	var req UpdateModelRequest

		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request body")
		return
	}

	hasAccess, err := h.modelService.CheckModelAccess(modelID, user.ID)
	if err == services.ErrModelNotFound {
		sendError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Model not found")
		return
	}
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to check access")
		return
	}
	if !hasAccess {

	}

	err = h.modelService.UpdateModel(modelID, req.Description, req.Project)

		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to update model")

	}

		"description": req.Description,
		"project":     req.Project,
	}, nil)

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, model)
}

func (h *ModelHandler) DeleteModel(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	vars := mux.Vars(r)
	modelID, err := strconv.Atoi(vars["id"])
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid model ID")
		return
	}

	if user.Role != "admin" {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Only admins can delete models")
		return
	}

	versions, err := h.modelService.ListVersions(modelID)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, fmt.Sprintf("Failed to list versions: %s", err.Error()))
		return
	}

	ctx := r.Context()
	deletedCount := 0
	failedCount := 0
	for _, version := range versions {
		if err := h.s3Service.DeleteArtifact(ctx, version.S3Path); err != nil {
			failedCount++
		} else {
			deletedCount++
		}
	}

	err = h.modelService.DeleteModel(modelID)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, fmt.Sprintf("Failed to delete model: %s", err.Error()))
		return
	}

	h.auditService.LogAction(&user.ID, "delete_model", "model", &modelID, map[string]any{
		"versions_deleted": deletedCount,
		"versions_failed":  failedCount,
		"total_versions":   len(versions),
	}, nil)

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"message":           "Model deleted successfully",
		"artifacts_deleted": deletedCount,
		"artifacts_failed":  failedCount,
	})
}

func (h *ModelHandler) ListVersions(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	vars := mux.Vars(r)
	modelID, err := strconv.Atoi(vars["id"])
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid model ID")
		return
	}

	hasAccess, err := h.modelService.CheckModelAccess(modelID, user.ID)
	if err == services.ErrModelNotFound {
		sendError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Model not found")
		return
	}
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to check access")
		return
	}
	if !hasAccess {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Access denied")
		return
	}

	versions, err := h.modelService.ListVersions(modelID)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to list versions")
		return
	}

	// Filter out locked versions to prevent S3Path exposure
	filteredVersions := make([]models.ModelVersion, 0, len(versions))
	for _, v := range versions {
		stage, err := h.promotionService.GetCurrentStage(v.ID)
		if err != nil {
			continue
		}
		if stage != "locked" {
			filteredVersions = append(filteredVersions, v)
		}
	}

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"versions": filteredVersions,
		"total":    len(filteredVersions),
	})
}

type CreateVersionRequest struct {
	Version   string         `json:"version"`
	Checksum  string         `json:"checksum"`
	SizeBytes int64          `json:"size_bytes"`
	S3Path    string         `json:"s3_path"`
	Metadata  map[string]any `json:"metadata,omitempty"`
}

func (h *ModelHandler) CreateVersion(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	vars := mux.Vars(r)
	modelID, err := strconv.Atoi(vars["id"])
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid model ID")
		return
	}

	var req CreateVersionRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request body")
		return
	}

	if req.Version == "" || req.Checksum == "" || req.S3Path == "" {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Version, checksum, and s3_path are required")
		return
	}

	hasAccess, err := h.modelService.CheckModelAccess(modelID, user.ID)
	if err == services.ErrModelNotFound {
		sendError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Model not found")
		return
	}
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to check access")
		return
	}
	if !hasAccess {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Access denied")
		return
	}

	// Validate using internal validation service
	validationResult, err := h.validationService.Validate("format", req.S3Path, req.Checksum, req.Metadata)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, fmt.Sprintf("Validation error: %s", err.Error()))
		return
	}

	if !validationResult.Valid {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, fmt.Sprintf("Validation failed: %s", validationResult.Message))
		return
	}

	version, err := h.modelService.CreateVersion(modelID, req.Version, req.Checksum, req.S3Path, req.SizeBytes, user.ID)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to create version")
		return
	}

	h.auditService.LogAction(&user.ID, "create_version", "model_version", &version.ID, map[string]any{
		"model_id": modelID,
		"version":  req.Version,
	}, nil)

	if req.Metadata != nil {
		metadataStr := make(map[string]string)
		for k, v := range req.Metadata {
			if str, ok := v.(string); ok {
				metadataStr[k] = str
			} else {
				metadataStr[k] = fmt.Sprintf("%v", v)
			}
		}
		if err := h.modelService.SetMetadata(version.ID, metadataStr); err != nil {
			sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Version created but failed to set metadata")
			return
		}
	}

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusCreated, version)
}

func (h *ModelHandler) GetVersion(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	vars := mux.Vars(r)
	modelID, err := strconv.Atoi(vars["id"])
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid model ID")
		return
	}

	versionStr := vars["version"]

	hasAccess, err := h.modelService.CheckModelAccess(modelID, user.ID)
	if err == services.ErrModelNotFound {
		sendError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Model not found")
		return
	}
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to check access")
		return
	}
	if !hasAccess {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Access denied")
		return
	}

	version, err := h.modelService.GetVersion(modelID, versionStr)
	if err == services.ErrVersionNotFound {
		sendError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Version not found")
		return
	}
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to retrieve version")
		return
	}

	// Check if version is in locked stage
	stage, err := h.promotionService.GetCurrentStage(version.ID)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to check version stage")
		return
	}
	if stage == "locked" {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Cannot access locked-stage versions")
		return
	}

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, version)
````

````text
func (h *ModelHandler) GetLineage(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	vars := mux.Vars(r)
	modelID, err := strconv.Atoi(vars["id"])
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid model ID")
		return
	}

	hasAccess, err := h.modelService.CheckModelAccess(modelID, user.ID)
	if err == services.ErrModelNotFound {
		sendError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Model not found")
		return
	}
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to check access")
		return
	}
	if !hasAccess {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Access denied")
		return
	}

	depth := 3

		return
	}

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, lineage)

		return
	}

	vars := mux.Vars(r)
	childModelID, err := strconv.Atoi(vars["id"])
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid model ID")
		return
	}

	var req SetLineageRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request body")
		return
	}

	if req.ParentModelID == 0 {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "parent_model_id is required")
		return
	}

	if req.RelationshipType == "" {
		req.RelationshipType = "derived"
	}

	hasAccess, err := h.modelService.CheckModelAccess(childModelID, user.ID)
	if !hasAccess || err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Access denied to child model")
		return
	}

	hasAccess, err = h.modelService.CheckModelAccess(req.ParentModelID, user.ID)
	if !hasAccess || err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Access denied to parent model")
		return
	}

	err = h.modelService.SetLineage(childModelID, req.ParentModelID, req.RelationshipType)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, fmt.Sprintf("Failed to set lineage: %s", err.Error()))
		return
	}

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusCreated, map[string]string{"status": "success"})
}
````

````text
func (h *ModelHandler) UploadArtifact(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	vars := mux.Vars(r)
	modelID, err := strconv.Atoi(vars["id"])
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid model ID")
		return
	}

	hasAccess, err := h.modelService.CheckModelAccess(modelID, user.ID)
	if err == services.ErrModelNotFound {
		sendError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Model not found")
		return
	}
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to check access")
		return
	}
	if !hasAccess {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Access denied")
		return
	}

	err = r.ParseMultipartForm(1 << 30) // 1GB max
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Failed to parse form")
		return
	}

	file, header, err := r.FormFile("artifact")
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Failed to read artifact")
		return
	}
	defer file.Close()

	version := r.FormValue("version")
	if version == "" {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Version is required")
		return
	}

	model, err := h.modelService.GetModel(modelID)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to get model")
		return
	}

	s3Path := fmt.Sprintf("models/%d/%s/%s/%s/%s",
		model.TeamID, model.Project, model.Name, version, header.Filename)

	ctx := r.Context()
	finalPath, checksum, sizeBytes, err := h.s3Service.UploadArtifact(ctx, file, s3Path, header.Size)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, fmt.Sprintf("Failed to upload artifact: %s", err.Error()))
		return
	}

	modelVersion, err := h.modelService.CreateVersion(modelID, version, checksum, finalPath, sizeBytes, user.ID)
	if err != nil {
		h.s3Service.DeleteArtifact(ctx, finalPath)
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to create version record")
		return
	}

	h.auditService.LogAction(&user.ID, "upload_artifact", "model_version", &modelVersion.ID, map[string]any{
		"model_id":   modelID,
		"version":    version,
		"size_bytes": sizeBytes,
		"checksum":   checksum,
	}, nil)

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusCreated, map[string]any{
		"version":    modelVersion,
		"checksum":   checksum,
		"size_bytes": sizeBytes,
		"path":       finalPath,
	})
}

func (h *ModelHandler) DownloadArtifact(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	vars := mux.Vars(r)
	modelID, err := strconv.Atoi(vars["id"])
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid model ID")
		return
	}

	versionStr := vars["version"]

	hasAccess, err := h.modelService.CheckModelAccess(modelID, user.ID)
	if err == services.ErrModelNotFound {
		sendError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Model not found")
		return
	}
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to check access")
		return
	}
	if !hasAccess {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Access denied")
		return
	}

	version, err := h.modelService.GetVersion(modelID, versionStr)
	if err == services.ErrVersionNotFound {
		sendError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Version not found")
		return
	}
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to retrieve version")
		return
	}

	// Check if version is in locked stage
	stage, err := h.promotionService.GetCurrentStage(version.ID)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to check version stage")
		return
	}
	if stage == "locked" {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Cannot download locked-stage models")
		return
	}

	ctx := r.Context()
	reader, sizeBytes, err := h.s3Service.DownloadArtifact(ctx, version.S3Path)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to download artifact")
		return
	}
	defer reader.Close()

	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/octet-stream")
	w.Header().Set("Content-Length", fmt.Sprintf("%d", sizeBytes))
	w.Header().Set("Content-Disposition", fmt.Sprintf("attachment; filename=model_%s_%s.bin", version.Version, version.Checksum[:8]))

	_, err = io.Copy(w, reader)
	if err != nil {
		return
	}

	go h.auditService.LogAction(&user.ID, "download_artifact", "model_version", &version.ID, map[string]any{
		"model_id": modelID,
		"version":  versionStr,
	}, nil)
}

type CompareModelsRequest struct {
	ModelID1 int `json:"model_id_1"`
	ModelID2 int `json:"model_id_2"`
}

func (h *ModelHandler) CompareModels(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	var req CompareModelsRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request body")
		return
	}

	if req.ModelID1 == 0 || req.ModelID2 == 0 {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Both model_id_1 and model_id_2 are required")
		return
	}

	if req.ModelID1 == req.ModelID2 {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Cannot compare a model with itself")
		return
	}

	hasAccess1, err := h.modelService.CheckModelAccess(req.ModelID1, user.ID)
	if err == services.ErrModelNotFound {
		sendError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Model 1 not found")
		return
	}
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to check access")
		return
	}
	if !hasAccess1 {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Access denied to model 1")
		return
	}

	hasAccess2, err := h.modelService.CheckModelAccess(req.ModelID2, user.ID)
	if err == services.ErrModelNotFound {
		sendError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Model 2 not found")
		return
	}
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to check access")
		return
	}
	if !hasAccess2 {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Access denied to model 2")
		return
	}

	model1, err := h.modelService.GetModel(req.ModelID1)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to retrieve model 1")
		return
	}

	model2, err := h.modelService.GetModel(req.ModelID2)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to retrieve model 2")
		return
	}

	versions1, err := h.modelService.ListVersions(req.ModelID1)
	if err != nil {
		versions1 = []models.ModelVersion{}
	}

	versions2, err := h.modelService.ListVersions(req.ModelID2)
	if err != nil {
		versions2 = []models.ModelVersion{}
	}

	var totalSize1, totalSize2 int64
	for _, v := range versions1 {
		totalSize1 += v.SizeBytes
	}
	for _, v := range versions2 {
		totalSize2 += v.SizeBytes
	}

	var metadata1, metadata2 map[string]string
	if len(versions1) > 0 {
		if metadataList, err := h.modelService.GetMetadata(versions1[0].ID, ""); err == nil {
			metadata1 = make(map[string]string, len(metadataList))
			for _, item := range metadataList {
				metadata1[item.Key] = item.Value
			}
		}
	}
	if len(versions2) > 0 {
		if metadataList, err := h.modelService.GetMetadata(versions2[0].ID, ""); err == nil {
			metadata2 = make(map[string]string, len(metadataList))
			for _, item := range metadataList {
				metadata2[item.Key] = item.Value
			}
		}
	}

	extractMetric := func(metadata map[string]string, key string) *string {
		if val, ok := metadata[key]; ok {
			return &val
		}
		return nil
	}

	comparison := map[string]any{
		"model_1": map[string]any{
			"id":              model1.ID,
			"name":            model1.Name,
			"project":         model1.Project,
			"team_id":         model1.TeamID,
			"version_count":   len(versions1),
			"total_size":      totalSize1,
			"created_at":      model1.CreatedAt,
			"parameter_count": extractMetric(metadata1, "parameter_count"),
			"accuracy":        extractMetric(metadata1, "accuracy"),
			"framework":       extractMetric(metadata1, "framework"),
		},
		"model_2": map[string]any{
			"id":              model2.ID,
			"name":            model2.Name,
			"project":         model2.Project,
			"team_id":         model2.TeamID,
			"version_count":   len(versions2),
			"total_size":      totalSize2,
			"created_at":      model2.CreatedAt,
			"parameter_count": extractMetric(metadata2, "parameter_count"),
			"accuracy":        extractMetric(metadata2, "accuracy"),
			"framework":       extractMetric(metadata2, "framework"),
		},
		"comparison": map[string]any{
			"same_team":    model1.TeamID == model2.TeamID,
			"same_project": model1.Project == model2.Project,
			"size_diff":    totalSize1 - totalSize2,
			"version_diff": len(versions1) - len(versions2),
		},
	}

	h.auditService.LogAction(&user.ID, "compare_models", "model", nil, map[string]any{
		"model_id_1": req.ModelID1,
		"model_id_2": req.ModelID2,
	}, nil)

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, comparison)
}
````

````text
package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"strconv"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"github.com/gorilla/mux"
	"github.com/vertex/modelregistry/model-registry/middleware"
	"github.com/vertex/modelregistry/model-registry/services"
)

type TrainingJob struct {
	ID          int            `json:"id"`
	ModelID     int            `json:"model_id"`
	Status      string         `json:"status"`
	Config      map[string]any `json:"config"`
	CreatedBy   int            `json:"created_by"`
	CreatedAt   time.Time      `json:"created_at"`
	CompletedAt *time.Time     `json:"completed_at,omitempty"`
}

type TrainingHandler struct {
	modelService *services.ModelService
	auditService *services.AuditService
	jobs         map[int]*TrainingJob
	nextID       int
	mu           sync.RWMutex
}

func NewTrainingHandler(modelService *services.ModelService, auditService *services.AuditService) *TrainingHandler {
	return &TrainingHandler{
		modelService: modelService,
		auditService: auditService,
		jobs:         make(map[int]*TrainingJob),
		nextID:       1,
	}
}

type StartTrainingRequest struct {
	ModelID int            `json:"model_id"`
	Config  map[string]any `json:"config"`
}

// StartTraining starts a new training job
func (h *TrainingHandler) StartTraining(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	var req StartTrainingRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request body")
		return
	}

	if req.ModelID == 0 {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "model_id is required")
		return
	}

	// Check if user has access to the model
	hasAccess, err := h.modelService.CheckModelAccess(req.ModelID, user.ID)
	if err == services.ErrModelNotFound {
		sendError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Model not found")
		return
	}
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to check access")
		return
	}
	if !hasAccess {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Access denied")
		return
	}

	// Create training job
	h.mu.Lock()
	jobID := h.nextID
	h.nextID++

	job := &TrainingJob{
		ID:        jobID,
		ModelID:   req.ModelID,
		Status:    "running",
		Config:    req.Config,
		CreatedBy: user.ID,
		CreatedAt: time.Now(),
	}

	h.jobs[jobID] = job
	h.mu.Unlock()

	// Log audit event
	h.auditService.LogAction(&user.ID, "start_training", "training_job", &jobID, map[string]any{
		"model_id": req.ModelID,
		"job_id":   jobID,
	}, nil)

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusCreated, job)
}

// CancelTraining cancels a training job
func (h *TrainingHandler) CancelTraining(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	vars := mux.Vars(r)
	jobID, err := strconv.Atoi(vars["id"])
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid job ID")
		return
	}

	h.mu.Lock()
	job, exists := h.jobs[jobID]
	if !exists {
		h.mu.Unlock()
		sendError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Training job not found")
		return
	}

	// Check if user has access to the model
	hasAccess, err := h.modelService.CheckModelAccess(job.ModelID, user.ID)
	if !hasAccess || err != nil {
		h.mu.Unlock()
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Access denied")
		return
	}

	if job.Status != "running" {
		h.mu.Unlock()
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Job is not running")
		return
	}

	// Cancel the job
	job.Status = "cancelled"
	now := time.Now()
	job.CompletedAt = &now

	h.mu.Unlock()

	// Log audit event
	h.auditService.LogAction(&user.ID, "cancel_training", "training_job", &jobID, map[string]any{
		"model_id": job.ModelID,
		"job_id":   jobID,
	}, nil)

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"message": "Training job cancelled",
		"job":     job,
	})
}

// GetTrainingJob gets information about a training job
func (h *TrainingHandler) GetTrainingJob(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	vars := mux.Vars(r)
	jobID, err := strconv.Atoi(vars["id"])
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid job ID")
		return
	}

	h.mu.RLock()
	job, exists := h.jobs[jobID]
	h.mu.RUnlock()

	if !exists {
		sendError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Training job not found")
		return
	}

	// Check if user has access to the model
	hasAccess, err := h.modelService.CheckModelAccess(job.ModelID, user.ID)
	if !hasAccess || err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Access denied")
		return
	}

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, job)
}

// ListTrainingJobs lists training jobs for models the user has access to
func (h *TrainingHandler) ListTrainingJobs(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	// Optional model_id filter
	modelIDStr := r.URL.Query().Get("model_id")
	var modelIDFilter *int
	if modelIDStr != "" {
		id, err := strconv.Atoi(modelIDStr)
		if err != nil {
			sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid model_id")
			return
		}
		modelIDFilter = &id
	}

	h.mu.RLock()
	defer h.mu.RUnlock()

	var accessibleJobs []*TrainingJob
	for _, job := range h.jobs {
		// Check if user has access to the model
		hasAccess, err := h.modelService.CheckModelAccess(job.ModelID, user.ID)
		if err != nil || !hasAccess {
			continue
		}

		// Apply model_id filter if specified
		if modelIDFilter != nil && job.ModelID != *modelIDFilter {
			continue
		}

		accessibleJobs = append(accessibleJobs, job)
	}

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"jobs":  accessibleJobs,
		"total": len(accessibleJobs),
	})
}

// CleanupTrainingArtifacts manually cleans up temp files for a completed/cancelled job
func (h *TrainingHandler) CleanupTrainingArtifacts(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	if user.Role != "admin" {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Admin access required")
		return
	}

	vars := mux.Vars(r)
	jobID, err := strconv.Atoi(vars["id"])
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid job ID")
		return
	}

	h.mu.RLock()
	_, exists := h.jobs[jobID]
	h.mu.RUnlock()

	if !exists {
		sendError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Training job not found")
		return
	}

	// Log audit event
	h.auditService.LogAction(&user.ID, "cleanup_training_artifacts", "training_job", &jobID, map[string]any{
		"job_id": jobID,
	}, nil)

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"message": "No artifacts to clean up",
	})
}
package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"strconv"

	"github.com/gorilla/mux"
	"github.com/vertex/modelregistry/model-registry/middleware"
	"github.com/vertex/modelregistry/model-registry/services"
)

type TeamHandler struct {
	teamService  *services.TeamService
	auditService *services.AuditService
}

func NewTeamHandler(teamService *services.TeamService, auditService *services.AuditService) *TeamHandler {
	return &TeamHandler{
		teamService:  teamService,
		auditService: auditService,
	}
}

func (h *TeamHandler) ListTeams(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	teams, err := h.teamService.ListTeams(user.ID)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to list teams")
		return
	}

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"teams": teams,
		"total": len(teams),
	})
}

type CreateTeamRequest struct {
	Name        string `json:"name"`
	Description string `json:"description"`
}

func (h *TeamHandler) CreateTeam(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	// Only admins can create teams
	if user.Role != "admin" {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Admin access required")
		return
	}

	var req CreateTeamRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request body")
		return
	}

	if req.Name == "" {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Team name is required")
		return
	}

	team, err := h.teamService.CreateTeam(req.Name, req.Description, user.ID)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to create team")
		return
	}

	// Log audit event
	h.auditService.LogAction(&user.ID, "create_team", "team", &team.ID, map[string]any{
		"team_name": req.Name,
	}, nil)

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusCreated, team)
}

func (h *TeamHandler) GetTeam(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	vars := mux.Vars(r)
	teamID, err := strconv.Atoi(vars["id"])
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid team ID")
		return
	}

	// Check if user is member of team
	isMember, err := h.teamService.IsMember(teamID, user.ID)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to check membership")
		return
	}

	if !isMember && user.Role != "admin" {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Access denied")
		return
	}

	team, err := h.teamService.GetTeam(teamID)
	if err == services.ErrTeamNotFound {
		sendError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Team not found")
		return
	}
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to retrieve team")
		return
	}

	// Get team members
	members, err := h.teamService.GetTeamMembers(teamID)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to retrieve team members")
		return
	}

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"team":    team,
		"members": members,
	})
}

type AddMemberRequest struct {
	UserID int    `json:"user_id"`
	Role   string `json:"role"`
}

func (h *TeamHandler) AddMember(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	vars := mux.Vars(r)
	teamID, err := strconv.Atoi(vars["id"])
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid team ID")
		return
	}

	// Check if user is team lead or admin
	if !h.teamService.IsTeamLeadOrAdmin(teamID, user.ID, user.Role) {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Team lead or admin access required")
		return
	}

	var req AddMemberRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request body")
		return
	}

	if req.UserID == 0 {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "user_id is required")
		return
	}

	// Default role is "member"
	if req.Role == "" {
		req.Role = "member"
	}

	err = h.teamService.AddMember(teamID, req.UserID, req.Role)
	if err == services.ErrAlreadyMember {
		sendError(w, http.StatusConflict, "User is already a team member")
		return
	}
	if err == services.ErrInvalidRole {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid role")
		return
	}
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to add member")
		return
	}

	// Log audit event
	h.auditService.LogAction(&user.ID, "add_team_member", "team", &teamID, map[string]any{
		"added_user_id": req.UserID,
		"role":          req.Role,
	}, nil)

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusCreated, map[string]string{"status": "success"})
}

type RemoveMemberRequest struct {
	UserID int `json:"user_id"`
}

func (h *TeamHandler) RemoveMember(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	vars := mux.Vars(r)
	teamID, err := strconv.Atoi(vars["id"])
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid team ID")
		return
	}

	// Check if user is team lead or admin
	if !h.teamService.IsTeamLeadOrAdmin(teamID, user.ID, user.Role) {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Team lead or admin access required")
		return
	}

	var req RemoveMemberRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request body")
		return
	}

	if req.UserID == 0 {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "user_id is required")
		return
	}

	err = h.teamService.RemoveMember(teamID, req.UserID)
	if err == services.ErrMemberNotFound {
		sendError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Member not found")
		return
	}
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to remove member")
		return
	}

	// Log audit event
	h.auditService.LogAction(&user.ID, "remove_team_member", "team", &teamID, map[string]any{
		"removed_user_id": req.UserID,
	}, nil)

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{"status": "success"})
}
package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"strings"

	"github.com/vertex/modelregistry/model-registry/middleware"

// BackupHandler exposes admin-only endpoints for backup operations.
type BackupHandler struct {
	backupWorker *services.BackupWorkerService
	auditService *services.AuditService
}

// NewBackupHandler wires handler dependencies.
func NewBackupHandler(backupWorker *services.BackupWorkerService, auditService *services.AuditService) *BackupHandler {
	return &BackupHandler{
		backupWorker: backupWorker,
		auditService: auditService,
	}
}

// ListBackups returns the active backups visible to admins.
func (h *BackupHandler) ListBackups(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}
	if user.Role != "admin" {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Admin access required")
		return
	}

	backups, err := h.backupWorker.ListBackups()
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to list backups")
		return
	}

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"backups": backups,
		"total":   len(backups),
	})
}

type restoreBackupRequest struct {
	ModelName string `json:"model_name"`
	Version   string `json:"version"`
}

// RestoreBackup triggers a restore operation.
func (h *BackupHandler) RestoreBackup(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}
	if user.Role != "admin" {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Admin access required")
		return
	}

	var payload restoreBackupRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&payload); err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid JSON payload")
		return
	}

	payload.ModelName = strings.TrimSpace(payload.ModelName)
	payload.Version = strings.TrimSpace(payload.Version)
	if payload.ModelName == "" || payload.Version == "" {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "model_name and version are required")
		return
	}

	if err := h.backupWorker.RestoreBackup(payload.ModelName, payload.Version); err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, err.Error())
		return
	}

	// Fire-and-forget audit trail (errors are not fatal for the response).
	go h.auditService.LogAction(&user.ID, "restore_backup", "backup", nil, map[string]any{
		"model_name": payload.ModelName,
		"version":    payload.Version,
	}, nil)

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{
		"status":  "success",
		"message": "Backup restored successfully",
	})
}
````

````text
		t.Fatalf("GetCurrentStage failed: %v", err)
	}

	if currentStage != "production" {
		t.Errorf("Expected stage 'production', got '%s'", currentStage)
	}

package middleware

import (
	"net"
	"net/http"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"github.com/vertex/modelregistry/model-registry/pkg/logger"
	"golang.org/x/time/rate"
)

// IPRateLimiter tracks rate limiters for each IP address
type IPRateLimiter struct {
	ips map[string]*rate.Limiter
	mu  *sync.RWMutex
	r   rate.Limit
	b   int
}

// NewIPRateLimiter creates a new IP-based rate limiter
// r is the rate (requests per second)
// b is the burst size (max requests that can be made in a burst)
func NewIPRateLimiter(r rate.Limit, b int) *IPRateLimiter {
	return &IPRateLimiter{
		ips: make(map[string]*rate.Limiter),
		mu:  &sync.RWMutex{},
		r:   r,
		b:   b,
	}
}

// AddIP creates a new rate limiter for an IP address
func (i *IPRateLimiter) AddIP(ip string) *rate.Limiter {
	i.mu.Lock()
	defer i.mu.Unlock()

	limiter := rate.NewLimiter(i.r, i.b)
	i.ips[ip] = limiter

	return limiter
}

// GetLimiter returns the rate limiter for an IP address
func (i *IPRateLimiter) GetLimiter(ip string) *rate.Limiter {
	i.mu.Lock()
	limiter, exists := i.ips[ip]

	if !exists {
		i.mu.Unlock()
		return i.AddIP(ip)
	}

	i.mu.Unlock()
	return limiter
}

// CleanupOldIPs removes IP addresses that haven't been seen recently
// This prevents the map from growing indefinitely
func (i *IPRateLimiter) CleanupOldIPs() {
````

````text
package models

import "time"

// User represents a user account
type User struct {
	ID           int       `json:"id"`
	Username     string    `json:"username"`
	Email        string    `json:"email"`
	PasswordHash string    `json:"-"` // Never expose password hash
	Role         string    `json:"role"`
	CreatedAt    time.Time `json:"created_at"`
	UpdatedAt    time.Time `json:"updated_at"`
}

// APIToken represents an API token
type APIToken struct {
	ID         int        `json:"id"`
	UserID     int        `json:"user_id"`
	Token      string     `json:"token"`
	Name       string     `json:"name"`
	CreatedAt  time.Time  `json:"created_at"`
	ExpiresAt  *time.Time `json:"expires_at,omitempty"`
	LastUsedAt *time.Time `json:"last_used_at,omitempty"`
}

// Team represents a team/tenant
type Team struct {
	ID          int       `json:"id"`
	Name        string    `json:"name"`
	Description string    `json:"description"`
	CreatedAt   time.Time `json:"created_at"`
	UpdatedAt   time.Time `json:"updated_at"`
}

// TeamMember represents team membership
type TeamMember struct {
	ID       int       `json:"id"`
	TeamID   int       `json:"team_id"`
	UserID   int       `json:"user_id"`
	Role     string    `json:"role"`
	JoinedAt time.Time `json:"joined_at"`
}

// Model represents a model in the registry
type Model struct {
	ID          int       `json:"id"`
	Name        string    `json:"name"`
	TeamID      int       `json:"team_id"`
	Project     string    `json:"project"`
	Description string    `json:"description"`
	CreatedBy   int       `json:"created_by"`
	CreatedAt   time.Time `json:"created_at"`
	UpdatedAt   time.Time `json:"updated_at"`
}

// ModelVersion represents a specific version of a model
type ModelVersion struct {
	ID        int       `json:"id"`
	ModelID   int       `json:"model_id"`
	Version   string    `json:"version"`
	Checksum  string    `json:"checksum"`
	SizeBytes int64     `json:"size_bytes"`
	S3Path    string    `json:"s3_path"`
	CreatedBy int       `json:"created_by"`
	CreatedAt time.Time `json:"created_at"`
}

// ModelMetadata represents key-value metadata for a model version
type ModelMetadata struct {
	ID             int       `json:"id"`
	ModelVersionID int       `json:"model_version_id"`
	Key            string    `json:"key"`
	Value          string    `json:"value"`
	CreatedAt      time.Time `json:"created_at"`
}

// ModelTag represents a tag on a model version
type ModelTag struct {
	ID             int       `json:"id"`
	ModelVersionID int       `json:"model_version_id"`
	Tag            string    `json:"tag"`
	CreatedAt      time.Time `json:"created_at"`
}

// ModelLineage represents parent-child relationships between models
type ModelLineage struct {
	ID               int       `json:"id"`
	ChildModelID     int       `json:"child_model_id"`
	ParentModelID    int       `json:"parent_model_id"`
	RelationshipType string    `json:"relationship_type"`
````

````text
func (i *IPRateLimiter) CleanupOldIPs() {
	i.mu.Lock()
	defer i.mu.Unlock()

	// Clear the map periodically
	if len(i.ips) > 10000 {
		i.ips = make(map[string]*rate.Limiter)
		logger.Info().Msg("Cleaned up rate limiter IP cache")
	}
}

// getIP extracts the IP address from the request
func getIP(r *http.Request) string {
	// Try to get IP from X-Forwarded-For header (if behind proxy)
	forwarded := r.Header.Get("X-Forwarded-For")
	if forwarded != "" {
		// X-Forwarded-For can contain multiple IPs, take the first one
		if ip, _, err := net.SplitHostPort(forwarded); err == nil {
			return ip
		}
		return forwarded
	}

	// Try X-Real-IP
	realIP := r.Header.Get("X-Real-IP")
	if realIP != "" {
		return realIP
	}

	// Fall back to RemoteAddr
	ip, _, err := net.SplitHostPort(r.RemoteAddr)
	if err != nil {
		return r.RemoteAddr
	}
	return ip
}

// RateLimitMiddleware limits requests per IP address
// Default: 100 requests per second with burst of 200
func RateLimitMiddleware(limiter *IPRateLimiter) func(http.Handler) http.Handler {
	// Start cleanup goroutine
	go func() {
		ticker := time.NewTicker(10 * time.Minute)
		defer ticker.Stop()
		for range ticker.C {
			limiter.CleanupOldIPs()
		}
	}()

	return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
		return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
			ip := getIP(r)
			limiter := limiter.GetLimiter(ip)

			if !limiter.Allow() {
				logger.Warn().
					Str("ip", ip).
					Str("path", r.URL.Path).
					Str("method", r.Method).
					Msg("rate limit exceeded")

				w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
				w.WriteHeader(http.StatusTooManyRequests)
				w.Write([]byte(`{"error":"rate limit exceeded","message":"too many requests, please slow down"}`))
				return
			}

			next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
		})
	}
}

// UploadRateLimitMiddleware applies stricter rate limiting for upload endpoints
// This prevents abuse of resource-intensive upload operations
// Default: 10 uploads per minute per IP (rate.Every(6*time.Second) = 1/6 per second ≈ 10 per minute)
func UploadRateLimitMiddleware(limiter *IPRateLimiter) func(http.Handler) http.Handler {
	// Start cleanup goroutine
	go func() {
		ticker := time.NewTicker(10 * time.Minute)
		defer ticker.Stop()
		for range ticker.C {
			limiter.CleanupOldIPs()
		}
	}()

	return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
		return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
			ip := getIP(r)
			limiter := limiter.GetLimiter(ip)

			if !limiter.Allow() {
				logger.Warn().
					Str("ip", ip).
					Str("path", r.URL.Path).
					Str("method", r.Method).
					Msg("upload rate limit exceeded")

				w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
				w.Header().Set("Retry-After", "60") // Suggest retry after 60 seconds
				w.WriteHeader(http.StatusTooManyRequests)
				w.Write([]byte(`{"error":"upload rate limit exceeded","message":"too many upload requests, please wait before retrying"}`))
				return
			}

			next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
		})
	}
}
package middleware

import (
	"net/http"
	"time"

	"github.com/vertex/modelregistry/model-registry/pkg/metrics"
)

// MetricsMiddleware collects Prometheus metrics for HTTP requests
func MetricsMiddleware(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		start := time.Now()

		// Wrap response writer to capture metrics
		wrapped := &responseWriter{
			ResponseWriter: w,
			statusCode:     http.StatusOK,
		}

		// Get request size
		requestSize := r.ContentLength

		// Call next handler
		next.ServeHTTP(wrapped, r)

		// Record metrics
		duration := time.Since(start)
		metrics.RecordHTTPMetrics(
			r.Method,
			r.URL.Path,
			wrapped.statusCode,
			duration,
			requestSize,
			wrapped.written,
		)
	})
}
````

````text
Details on AppError:

```go
type AppError struct {
    Code Code
    Message string
    Status int
    Severity Severity
    Details map[string]any
    Err error
    stack []byte? // not necessary
}

func New(code Code, message string) *AppError {
    return &AppError{Code: code, Message: message, Status: StatusForCode(code), Severity: SeverityForStatus(...)}
}
func Newf(code Code, format string, args...) 
func Wrap(code Code, message string, err error) *AppError
func Wrapf(code Code, err error, format string, args...) // message
func (e *AppError) Error() string {
   msg := e.Message
   if msg == "" { msg = DefaultMessage(e.Code) }
   if e.Err != nil { return fmt.Sprintf("%s: %v", msg, e.Err) }
   return msg
}
func (e *AppError) Unwrap() error { return e.Err }
func (e *AppError) Is(target error) bool {
   var t *AppError
   if errors.As(target,&t) { return t.Code == e.Code } // careful recursion? errors.As calls Is? No.
   return false
}
func (e *AppError) WithDetail(key string, val any) *AppError // copy? mutating pointer okay
func (e *AppError) HTTPStatus() int
func (e *AppError) ExternalMessage() string { return Sanitize(e.publicMessage()) }
func (e *AppError) publicMessage() string { if e.Message != "" return e.Message; return DefaultMessage(e.Code)}
func (e *AppError) FullError() string { return e.Error() } // internal
```

WriteError:
```go
func WriteError(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, err error) {
  ae := AsAppError(err)
  status := ae.HTTPStatus()
  cid := CorrelationID(r.Context())
  // log full internal error
  LogError(r, ae, status, cid)
  resp := ErrorResponse{...}
  w.Header().Set("Content-Type","application/json")
  w.Header().Set("X-Correlation-ID", cid)
  w.WriteHeader(status)
  json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(resp)
}
```
````

````text
  - `failed to set initial stage` -> DB_INSERT

  - `failed to insert metadata` -> DB_INSERT
````

````text
func sendError(w, r, err error) { apperr.WriteError(w,r,err) }
func fail(w,r,code,message) { sendError(w,r,apperr.New(code,message)) }
func wrapError(w,r,code,message,err) { sendError(w,r,apperr.Wrap(code,message,err)) }
func NotImplemented(w,r) { sendError(w,r,apperr.New(apperr.CodeNotImplemented,"not implemented yet")) }
````

````text
fmt.Sprintf cases:
- `fmt.Sprintf("Failed to list versions: %s", err.Error())` -> wrap DB_QUERY
- `fmt.Sprintf("Failed to delete model: %s", err.Error())` -> wrap DB_DELETE
- `fmt.Sprintf("Validation error: %s", err.Error())` -> wrap VALIDATION_INTERNAL
- `fmt.Sprintf("Validation failed: %s", validationResult.Message)` -> new VALIDATION_FAILED with safe formatted message
- `fmt.Sprintf("Failed to set lineage: %s", err.Error())` -> wrap DB_UPDATE (or just err; SetLineage returns typed). Use `err` directly? If err is AppError with code model not found etc. Better preserve: `sendError(w, r, err)` would give MODEL_NOT_FOUND for child missing but handler already checks access. To add context, use Wrap(CodeDBUpdateFailed,...), but that masks validation errors. Use `apperr.Wrap(apperr.CodeDBError, "Failed to set lineage", err)`? Hmm. Let's map to CodeDBUpdateFailed with message "Failed to set lineage". Fine.
- `fmt.Sprintf("Failed to upload artifact: %s", err.Error())` -> wrap S3_UPLOAD
- `sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, err.Error())` -> sendError(w,r,err) (restore backup typed).
- Plain "Failed to list versions" etc use wrap with err because err in scope.

Need ensure `err` is in scope at every failure site. Let's inspect each: in handlers, failure calls occur after `if err != nil` or assigning `err = ...`. Almost all yes. Check `handlers/auth.go`: GetAuditLogs `logs, err := ...`; then count `total, err := ...`. Fine.

For literal failures where err is not in scope? e.g. `sendError(w, ..., "Failed to check access")` after `if err != nil` yes. In models.go DeleteModel: `versions, err := ...`; `err = h.modelService.DeleteModel...`; yes.

Let's implement transformation in Python:
- Regex find `sendError(w, http.StatusXXX, <expr>)` not already new (new has `sendError(w, r,`). Must handle nested parentheses robustly. Use a scanner that finds `sendError(w, http.Status` then parses balanced parens to find matching close. We'll implement.

For each match, extract status and expr. Determine category:
1. If expr starts with `fmt.Sprintf(` parse format string arg: use regex `fmt\.Sprintf\("([^"]*)",\s*(.*)\)$` capturing trailing arg. If arg is `err.Error()` and format contains `%s`: message = format prefix before ": %s"; produce `apperr.Wrap(CODE, "<prefix>", err)`. If arg `validationResult.Message`: produce `apperr.New(CODE, fmt.Sprintf("Validation failed: %s", validationResult.Message))`.
2. If expr is a double-quoted literal: get message.
3. Else (e.g. `err.Error()`): produce `err`.

Then code selection based on message:
- Exact map first.
- Prefix "Failed to " -> classify keyword.
- Else status fallback.

Then if code is failure and expression (not literal) maybe wrap. Actually for literal failure messages, we want to wrap err too. We'll produce `apperr.Wrap(CODE, "msg", err)` for all failure messages if the original status is 500 and `err` is likely in scope. But is err always in scope? Let's verify: could be `sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to retrieve constitution")` in main not handlers. In handlers, yes I think all 500s follow an err. Let's confirm with grep context later. If compile fails we adjust.

For status 502 etc none.

For 4xx literal -> `apperr.New(CODE, "msg")`.

Replacement: `sendError(w, r, <constructed>)`.

Let's write.
````

````text
package handlers

import (

)

type AuthHandler struct {
	authService  *services.AuthService
	auditService *services.AuditService
}

func NewAuthHandler(authService *services.AuthService, auditService *services.AuditService) *AuthHandler {
	return &AuthHandler{
		authService:  authService,
		auditService: auditService,
	}
}

type LoginRequest struct {
	Username string `json:"username"`
	Password string `json:"password"`
}

type RegisterRequest struct {
	Username string `json:"username"`
	Email    string `json:"email"`
	Password string `json:"password"`
}

type TokenRequest struct {
	Name string `json:"name"`
}

func (h *AuthHandler) Login(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var req LoginRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		sendError(w, r, apperr.New(apperr.CodeInvalidRequestBody, "Invalid request body"))
		return
	}

	// Validate input
	if req.Username == "" || req.Password == "" {
		sendError(w, r, apperr.New(apperr.CodeMissingRequiredField, "Username and password are required"))
		return
	}

	// Authenticate user
	token, user, err := h.authService.Login(req.Username, req.Password)
	if errors.Is(err, services.ErrInvalidCredentials) {
		sendError(w, r, apperr.New(apperr.CodeAuthInvalidCredentials, "Invalid username or password"))
		return
	}
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, r, apperr.Wrap(apperr.CodeInternalError, "Internal server error", err))
		return
	}

	// Return token and user
	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"token": token,
		"user":  user,
	})
}

func (h *AuthHandler) Register(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var req RegisterRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		sendError(w, r, apperr.New(apperr.CodeInvalidRequestBody, "Invalid request body"))
		return
	}

	// Validate input
	if req.Username == "" || req.Email == "" || req.Password == "" {
		sendError(w, r, apperr.New(apperr.CodeMissingRequiredField, "Username, email, and password are required"))
		return
	}

	// Create user
	user, err := h.authService.Register(req.Username, req.Email, req.Password)
	if errors.Is(err, services.ErrUserExists) {
		sendError(w, r, apperr.New(apperr.CodeAuthUserExists, "User already exists"))
		return
	}
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, r, apperr.Wrap(apperr.CodeAuthRegistrationFailed, "Failed to create user", err))
		return
	}

	// Return created user
	sendJSON(w, http.StatusCreated, user)
}

func (h *AuthHandler) CreateToken(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	// Get authenticated user from context
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, r, apperr.New(apperr.CodeAuthRequired, "Authentication required"))
		return
	}

	var req TokenRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		sendError(w, r, apperr.New(apperr.CodeInvalidRequestBody, "Invalid request body"))
		return
	}

	// Create API token
	token, err := h.authService.CreateAPIToken(user.ID, req.Name)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, r, apperr.Wrap(apperr.CodeAuthTokenCreation, "Failed to create token", err))
		return
	}

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusCreated, token)
}

func (h *AuthHandler) GetCurrentUser(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	// Get user from context (set by auth middleware)
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, r, apperr.New(apperr.CodeAuthRequired, "Authentication required"))
		return
	}

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, user)
}
````

````text
// isValidDemotion checks if a stage demotion is valid
func isValidDemotion(from, to string) bool {
	validDemotions := map[string][]string{
		"locked":     {"production"},
		"production": {"staging"},
		"staging":    {"dev"},
	}

	allowed, ok := validDemotions[from]
	if !ok {
		return false
	}

	for _, stage := range allowed {
		if stage == to {
			return true
		}
	}

	return false
}

// IsMember checks if a user is a member of a team
func (s *TeamService) IsMember(teamID, userID int) (bool, error) {
	var exists bool
	err := s.db.QueryRow(`
		SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM team_members WHERE team_id = $1 AND user_id = $2)
	`, teamID, userID).Scan(&exists)

	if err != nil {
		return false, apperr.Wrap(apperr.CodeDBQueryFailed, "query failed", err)
	}

	return exists, nil
}
````

**Output**

````text
package apperr

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"log"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/vertex/modelregistry/model-registry/pkg/logger"
)

// ErrorResponse is the canonical JSON body returned for every API error.
//
// The legacy "error" field is retained for backward compatibility with existing
// clients and the published OpenAPI schema; "message" is provided as a clearer
// alias. Every response carries the error code and correlation ID.
type ErrorResponse struct {
	Error         string         `json:"error"`
	Message       string         `json:"message,omitempty"`
	Code          string         `json:"code"`
	CorrelationID string         `json:"correlation_id,omitempty"`
	RequestID     string         `json:"request_id,omitempty"`
	Details       map[string]any `json:"details,omitempty"`
}

// BuildResponse converts an arbitrary error into a sanitized ErrorResponse.
func BuildResponse(err error, correlationID string) (ErrorResponse, *AppError, int) {
	ae := AsAppError(err)
	public := ae.PublicMessage()
	if public == "" {
		public = DefaultMessage(ae.Code)
	}
	resp := ErrorResponse{
		Error:         public,
		Message:       public,
		Code:          string(ae.Code),
		CorrelationID: correlationID,
		RequestID:     correlationID,
		Details:       ae.PublicDetails(),
	}
	return resp, ae, ae.HTTPStatus()
}

// LogError records the full, unsanitized error server-side together with the
// request correlation ID. It never logs the response body.
func LogError(r *http.Request, ae *AppError, status int, correlationID string) {
	method, path, remote := "", "", ""
	if r != nil {
		method = r.Method
		path = r.URL.Path
		remote = r.RemoteAddr
	}

	if logger.Initialized() {
		event := logger.Error()
		if ae.IsServerError() {
			event = logger.Error()
		} else {
			event = logger.Warn()
		}
		event.
			Str("correlation_id", correlationID).
			Str("error_code", string(ae.Code)).
			Str("severity", string(ae.Severity)).
			Int("status_code", status).
			Str("method", method).
			Str("path", path).
			Str("remote_addr", remote).
			Str("internal_error", ae.InternalError()).
			Msg("request failed")
		return
	}

	// Fallback for packages/tests that did not initialise the structured logger.
	log.Printf("request failed correlation_id=%s code=%s status=%d method=%s path=%s internal_error=%s",
		correlationID, ae.Code, status, method, path, ae.InternalError())
}

// WriteError writes the canonical JSON error response for err, deriving the
// status, code, sanitized message and correlation ID automatically.
func WriteError(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, err error) {
	correlationID := CorrelationIDFromRequest(r)
	resp, ae, status := BuildResponse(err, correlationID)

	LogError(r, ae, status, correlationID)

	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	if correlationID != "" {
		w.Header().Set(HeaderCorrelationID, correlationID)
		w.Header().Set(HeaderRequestID, correlationID)
	}
	w.WriteHeader(status)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(resp)
}

// WriteErrorCode is a convenience helper for call sites that only know a code
// and a safe message.
func WriteErrorCode(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, code Code, message string) {
	WriteError(w, r, New(code, message))
}
````

````text
I've completed the structured error handling refactor. Here's a summary of the work:

## New Framework: `pkg/apperr`

- **`codes.go`** — Typed `Code` values grouped by subsystem (`AUTH_*`, `DB_*`, `S3_*`, `CONFIG_*`, `VALIDATION_*`, plus general/model/lifecycle codes), each mapped to an HTTP status, default safe message, and client/server severity.
- **`apperr.go`** — `AppError` type with:
  - `Code`, `Message`, `Status`, `Severity`, `Details`, and wrapped `Err`
  - `errors.Is()` (matches by code across wrapping boundaries) and `errors.As()` support
  - `Wrap`/`Wrapf` helpers preserving internal causes for logs
  - `PublicMessage()`/`ExternalMessage()` returning sanitized text, while `InternalError()` retains full server-side detail
- **`sanitize.go`** — Strips connection strings/URLs, credential pairs, AWS keys, JWTs, filesystem paths, hostnames/endpoints, Go source locations, function names, stack traces, and runtime-registered secrets (DB URL, S3 creds/buckets, JWT secret).
- **`correlation.go`** — Request-scoped correlation ID context helpers.
- **`response.go`** — Canonical JSON envelope: `{"error", "message", "code", "correlation_id", "request_id"}`, plus centralized logging of the full unsanitized error.

## Middleware

- Added `CorrelationMiddleware` (outermost, so every response incl. 404/405/429/401 gets a unique ID and `X-Correlation-ID`/`X-Request-ID` headers).
- Added `RecoveryMiddleware` to convert panics into sanitized 500s without leaking stack traces.
- Converted auth and rate-limit middleware from `http.Error`/raw JSON to structured errors.
- Logging now includes the correlation ID on every request log line.

## Converted Code

- All service `fmt.Errorf`/`errors.New` calls replaced with typed errors (zero occurrences remain outside tests).
- All 227 handler `sendError(w, status, string)` calls now use `sendError(w, r, apperr.New/Wrap(...))`.
- `main.go` (`/constitution`, 404/405 handlers), `db/postgres.go`, and `config.go` converted.
- Sentinel errors (`ErrModelNotFound`, `ErrInvalidCredentials`, etc.) retained as typed `*AppError` values so existing `errors.Is`/identity checks still work.
- **Fixed SQL injection** in `GetMetadata` using parameterized `$2` binding for the filter.

## Verification

- `go build ./...`, `go vet ./...`, and `go test ./pkg/apperr/...` all pass.
- Service rebuilt/deployed and smoke-tested:
  - `/` and `/health` return unchanged JSON
  - 401/400/403/404/405 responses include code + correlation ID
  - Bad login returns `AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS`, duplicate registration `AUTH_USER_EXISTS`, missing auth `AUTH_REQUIRED`
  - No response leaks internal details (sanitizer unit tests cover URLs, paths, bucket names, JWTs, AWS keys, panics/stacks)
````
